Brand.name: Foldline
Brand.markLabel: Foldline logo, a folded page corner

Home.title: Mark your place, quietly.
Home.lead: Keep track of every book you read on paper, on a screen or by ear. No feeds, no streaks, no pressure. Just you and your books.

formats.title: Paper, ebook, audio
formats.body: Every format on one gentle shelf.

private.title: Yours alone
private.body: Private by default. Nothing to perform.

rest.title: Rest or let go
rest.body: Pause a book or drop it. Both are perfectly fine.

Footer.note: Made for slow evenings and good books.

Library.title: Your library
Library.emptyBody: Soon you will add books here. For now, enjoy the quiet before the first page.

Login.title: Welcome back, reader
Login.lead: Your books missed you. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
Login.sentBody: If this email has a Foldline account, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once and expires soon.

errors.invalidEmail: That email does not look quite right. Mind checking it?
errors.generic: Something went sideways sending your link. Please try again in a moment.
errors.expiredLink: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Ask for a fresh one below.
errors.google: Google sign-in did not work this time. Try again, or use a magic link.
errors.notInvited: That Google account is not on the guest list yet. Try the one your invite was sent to, or ask for an invite.

Login.inviteOnly: Foldline is invite-only for now. Use the Google account your invite was sent to.
